#+title: Table demo

* Quarterly revenue

A simple table with a TBLFM line that sums each row.  The Total
column starts blank; `:Org table eval_formulas` fills it in from
the per-row formula.

| Quarter | Region A | Region B | Region C | Total |
|---------+----------+----------+----------+-------|
| Q1      |     1200 |      850 |      640 |       |
| Q2      |     1450 |      910 |      720 |       |
| Q3      |     1610 |      980 |      810 |       |
| Q4      |     1820 |     1100 |      950 |       |
#+TBLFM: $5=$2+$3+$4
